prompt: Create an original 60 second instrumental post-rock instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: clean electric guitars, electric bass, live drums. Style: delay guitar figures and patient layered crescendos. Tempo approximately 108 BPM; C major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: An energetic synth-wave track featuring driving drums, a prominent bassline, layered synthesizers with arpeggiated melodies, and electric guitar leads. It evokes a retro 80s feel.
description.zh: 一首充满活力的合成器波音乐，以强劲的鼓点、突出的贝斯线、带有琶音旋律的分层合成器和电吉他主音为特色。它唤起了80年代的复古感。
